E_ARG_INVALID.message: The argument is missing or out of range.
E_ARG_INVALID.hint: Run gaveta guide to see the values this command accepts.

E_VAULT_NOT_FOUND.hint: Pass --vault, set GAVETA_VAULT, or run the command inside a directory that contains .gaveta/.

E_REF_NOT_FOUND.hint: Check the id, path, or title, or search with gaveta search.

E_REF_AMBIGUOUS.message: The title or alias matches several notes.
E_REF_AMBIGUOUS.hint: Use the id or path. Candidates are listed in details.candidates.

E_LINK_BROKEN.message: The link points to an id that does not exist in the vault.
E_LINK_BROKEN.hint: Fix data-g-to or create the target note. gaveta doctor --fix does not repair broken links.

E_META_MISSING.message: A required metadata field is missing.
E_META_MISSING.hint: The note needs title, gaveta:id, gaveta:type, and gaveta:created.

E_ID_DUPLICATE.message: Two files share the same gaveta:id.
E_ID_DUPLICATE.hint: gaveta doctor lists both. Keep a single file with that id.

E_HTML_INVALID.message: The HTML cannot be parsed or contains an element outside the contract.
E_HTML_INVALID.hint: See allowed elements with gaveta guide.

E_TYPE_STRUCTURE.message: The structure does not match the note type.
E_TYPE_STRUCTURE.hint: A slides note needs at least one section.slide; a doc note needs an article; a todo note needs ul.tasks; dashboard, design, and artifact have their own rules (gaveta guide).

E_ARTIFACT_SANDBOX.message: The artifact iframe does not use the allowed sandbox.
E_ARTIFACT_SANDBOX.hint: Only sandbox="allow-scripts" is allowed, without allow-same-origin or other flags.

E_ARTIFACT_CSP.message: The artifact srcdoc CSP does not match the note.
E_ARTIFACT_CSP.hint: Re-import with --allow-cdn or remove remote scripts from the original HTML.

E_ARTIFACT_IFRAME.message: An artifact note must have a single iframe with srcdoc and no src.
E_ARTIFACT_IFRAME.hint: Scripts belong only inside the srcdoc; do not add more iframes or other attributes.

E_AUTH_REQUIRED.message: The local server session token is missing.
E_AUTH_REQUIRED.hint: Use the URL printed by gaveta serve or the Authorization: Bearer <token> header.

E_ORIGIN_INVALID.message: The Origin or Host header does not match this server.
E_ORIGIN_INVALID.hint: Only requests to 127.0.0.1 on this session's port are accepted.

E_TASK_INVALID.hint: data-g-due must be an ISO 8601 date and data-g-priority must be low, medium, or high.

E_UNSAFE_SCRIPT.message: The note contains a script, which is not allowed.
E_UNSAFE_SCRIPT.hint: Remove it. Gaveta does not run code inside notes.

E_UNSAFE_HANDLER.message: The note contains an event handler attribute (on*), which is not allowed.
E_UNSAFE_HANDLER.hint: Remove attributes that start with on.

E_UNSAFE_URL.message: The note contains a javascript: URL, which is not allowed.
E_UNSAFE_URL.hint: Use a relative path or an https URL.

E_UNSAFE_ELEMENT.message: The note contains an element that is not allowed for security reasons.
E_UNSAFE_ELEMENT.hint: iframe, object, embed, form, and base are not permitted.

E_PATH_OUTSIDE_VAULT.hint: Use a path inside the vault, without .. or symlinks that escape it.

E_CONFIG_INVALID.hint: Fix .gaveta/config.json. Unknown keys and wrong types are rejected.

E_SKILL_PATH.message: The skill install path is not valid.
E_SKILL_PATH.hint: Do not use .. or symlinks that escape the project or user directory.

E_SKILL_MODIFIED.message: The installed skill was edited manually.
E_SKILL_MODIFIED.hint: Reinstall with --force if you want to overwrite it.

E_HAS_BACKLINKS.message: The note has incoming links and cannot be deleted.
E_HAS_BACKLINKS.hint: Review affected notes or rerun with --force to turn them into pending links.

E_CONFLICT.message: The note changed since it was last read.
E_CONFLICT.hint: Read the note again and retry with the current hash in --if-match.

E_IF_MATCH_REQUIRED.message: The note hash in If-Match is missing.
E_IF_MATCH_REQUIRED.hint: Read the note with gaveta read or the read API and send its hash in If-Match.

E_SECTION_NOT_FOUND.message: No section with that id exists.
E_SECTION_NOT_FOUND.hint: Use gaveta read --as outline to list section ids.

E_TASK_NOT_FOUND.message: No task with that id exists in the note.
E_TASK_NOT_FOUND.hint: Use gaveta todo list <ref> to list task ids.

W_LINK_PENDING.hint: Create the missing note or pick one of the similarity suggestions.

W_LINK_HREF_STALE.hint: Run gaveta doctor --fix to recalculate the relative path.

W_NOTE_ORPHAN.message: The note has no incoming or outgoing links.
W_NOTE_ORPHAN.hint: Link it to another note or delete it if it is no longer needed.

W_THEME_HREF.message: The theme path does not match the note depth.
W_THEME_HREF.hint: Run gaveta doctor --fix to point to the theme with the correct relative path.

W_MERMAID_ASSET_MISSING.message: Mermaid scripts are missing from the vault .gaveta/ directory.
W_MERMAID_ASSET_MISSING.hint: Run gaveta init in the vault or copy mermaid.min.js and mermaid-boot.js from a new vault.

W_REL_UNKNOWN.message: rel is not in the vault vocabulary.
W_REL_UNKNOWN.hint: Add it to the configuration or use a suggested value. With rel.strict this becomes an error.

W_REMOTE_RESOURCE.hint: Download it with --fetch-assets or allow the domain in remoteAllowlist.

W_INLINE_STYLE_REMOVED.hint: Appearance comes from the vault theme, not the style attribute.

W_CLAUDE_DROPPED.message: Content from Claude HTML was dropped ({detail}).
W_CLAUDE_DROPPED.hint: Scripts, inline styles, and tags outside the contract are not kept for declarative note types.

W_CLASS_REMOVED.message: {count} classes outside the contract were removed.

W_UNSAFE_REMOVED.message: Unsafe content was removed on save.
W_UNSAFE_REMOVED.hint: The saved file no longer contains it.

E_IMPORT_PARSE.message: The Markdown could not be parsed.
E_IMPORT_PARSE.hint: Check the YAML front matter and file syntax.

E_IMPORT_ABORTED.message: Import was aborted and nothing was written.

W_IMPORT_UNSUPPORTED.message: Some Markdown syntax has no contract equivalent.
W_IMPORT_UNSUPPORTED.hint: It was kept as an HTML block.

W_IMPORT_SKIPPED.hint: This is the result of --on-conflict skip or --exclude.

W_EXPORT_LOSSY.message: Part of the note cannot be represented in Markdown and was degraded.
W_EXPORT_LOSSY.hint: The JSON output lists per file what was degraded.

E_RUNTIME_UNSUPPORTED.message: This environment is not supported: Node {version} detected; Node {minimum} or newer is required.
E_RUNTIME_UNSUPPORTED.hint: Install a recent Node version (for example `nvm install 22` or `brew install node`) and run gaveta again.

E_INDEX_CORRUPT.message: The SQLite index is corrupt and could not be rebuilt.
E_INDEX_CORRUPT.hint: Delete .gaveta/index.sqlite and run gaveta reindex. Note files are unchanged.

E_UPDATE_DIRTY.message: The git checkout has uncommitted changes.
E_UPDATE_DIRTY.hint: Commit or discard local changes before running gaveta update.

E_UPDATE_BRANCH.message: The git checkout is not on the main branch.
E_UPDATE_BRANCH.hint: Switch to main (git switch main) and run gaveta update again.

E_UPDATE_NOT_FAST_FORWARD.message: The update would require a non-fast-forward merge.
E_UPDATE_NOT_FAST_FORWARD.hint: Rebase or merge manually in the git checkout; gaveta update never forces or resets.

E_UPDATE_REMOTE.message: The origin remote does not point to the official Gaveta repository.
E_UPDATE_REMOTE.hint: Set origin to github.com/antonioaren/gaveta before updating.

E_UPDATE_FAILED.message: The update from git could not be completed.
E_UPDATE_FAILED.hint: Check that git and pnpm work in the checkout and try again.

E_UPDATE_UNSUPPORTED.message: This install method does not support automatic gaveta update.
E_UPDATE_UNSUPPORTED.hint: Follow the manual instructions from the command or see the README.

W_INDEX_RECOVERED.message: The index was damaged or incompatible and was recreated.
W_INDEX_RECOVERED.hint: Files were not modified. gaveta reindex repopulates it.

W_SKILL_OUTDATED.message: The installed skill is older than this CLI version.
W_SKILL_OUTDATED.hint: Run gaveta skill install to update it.

W_VAULT_ASSET_MODIFIED.message: A .gaveta/ file differs from the CLI bundled theme and was not overwritten.
W_VAULT_ASSET_MODIFIED.hint: Manually copy changes you want from the new theme or restore the default file.

W_VAULT_ASSETS_OUTDATED.message: .gaveta/ assets are older than this CLI version.
W_VAULT_ASSETS_OUTDATED.hint: Run gaveta update inside the vault or gaveta init to refresh theme.css without touching notes.

W_WEB_VIEWER_MISSING.message: The web viewer is not built; only the read API is running.
W_WEB_VIEWER_MISSING.hint: At the repository root run `pnpm build:web` and start gaveta serve again.

W_EMBED_CYCLE.message: Transclusion stopped: note {targetId} is already on the embed chain.

W_EMBED_DEPTH.hint: Split content across fewer nested gaveta-embed blocks.

W_EMBED_TARGET_MISSING.hint: Fix data-g-to or restore the target note.

W_EMBED_SECTION_MISSING.message: Section {sectionId} was not found in the embedded note.
W_EMBED_SECTION_MISSING.hint: Fix data-g-section or add the section to the target note.
